packageRules.description: chai v5+ is ESM-only and breaks the CommonJS Mocha test setup (spec/config/setup.js uses require). dirty-chai v3 in turn requires chai 6 (peer: '>=6.2.0 <7'), so it's pinned too. Stay on chai 4 / dirty-chai 2 until the test stack is migrated to ESM.

js-yaml is a transitive-only override kept for the merge-DoS hardening, backported to v4 in 4.3.0. Consumers (mocha, grunt) don't support v5's breaking rewrite (removed safeLoad/safeDump and the Type API). Stay on v4.
